description: Invisible Light Blocks This pack adds craftable Light Blocks (light source level 15) that are completely invisible when placed.
body:
Invisible Light Blocks

This pack adds craftable Light Blocks (light source level 15) that are completely invisible when placed.

Crafting Recipe:

![craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4cf21f0f654ed60558326dc32e41134966a05cd8_0.webp)

How to use:

Place like any normal block — creates invisible illumination

Prevents mob spawns without ruining your builds

Perfect for modern interiors, outdoor lighting, and hidden pathways

Features:

Fully survival-friendly

No commands required

Works in vanilla Minecraft
